test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

You must start your work without __some farther delay__.
solution:
The correct answer is **'any further delay'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the form of instruction.
 
• In other words, It's mentioned that without making any more delay, the work must be started.
 
• From the given options, the phrase **'without any further delay' **means **'no more delay'.**
 
• We use **further** to **mean 'more'.**
 
• **For example:**
 
 
• I don't want to discuss it **any further.**
 
• Let me explain this **a little further.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's **understand the concept **with some **more examples.**
 
• **Far** means **'a long way', a great distance, very much.**
 
 
• His new clothes are **far better **than the old ones.
 
 
 
• **Farther and Further **are **comparative adverbs **and forms of **'far'.**
 
 
• The fog is so thick that I can't see **farther than **about ten miles.
